test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a class, the average age of 28 boys is 13 years. Two boys whose ages are 'x' years and 21 years leave the class. If the new average age of the class is 13 years, then what is the value of 'x'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the average remains unchanged after some members leave, the average of those leaving must equal the initial average.

Average of 2 boys who left = Initial Average = 13 years.

Sum of ages of 2 boys who left = 2 × 13 = 26 years.

x + 21 = 26 ⇒ x = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Total boys (Initial) = 28 | Initial Average = 13 years | Leaving ages = x, 21 | Final Average = 13 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9281c8214493b0b76cd66db89efbe664b1772363a71a0d55c93157b4ec8212eb.png] 

⇒ Total age of 28 boys = 28 × 13 = 364 years

⇒ Remaining boys = 28 − 2 = 26 boys

⇒ Total age of 26 boys = 26 × 13 = 338 years

⇒ Age of boys who left = 364 − 338 = 26 years

⇒ x + 21 = 26

⇒ x = 26 − 21 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exclusion Rule in Average

When a person leaves, the new average decreases if the person's age > original average, and increases if the person's age < original average.

Sum Formula

Total Sum = Average × Number of items. For any changes, use Sumₙₑw = Sumₒₗd − Valueᵣₑₘₒvₑd + Valueₐddₑd.

Constant Average Case

If the average remains constant after removal/addition of 'n' items, the average of those 'n' items must equal the original average of the group.
